# Deliberate pause

`customer_support.pb.sla_management.deliberate_pause` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Pause only against a specific outstanding question that has been sent to the customer, and record the condition that restarts the clock at the same moment you pause it.

A pause with no question is a hiding place. A pause with no restart condition never restarts — the ticket leaves the running board and re-enters the world weeks later as a complaint. Writing the restart condition at pause time costs seconds and is the only practice that reliably prevents both.
